ScenarioDef.label: Roguelike: Tribal Hunters
ScenarioDef.description: Five hunters and their pack animals set out to cross a hostile land. Many hands and strong backs, but little technology.

scenario.summary: Five weak tribal hunters with bows and two pack muffalo.

ScenarioDef.label: Roguelike: Ice Nomads
ScenarioDef.description: Three hardened nomads who have lived through worse winters than this. They come dressed for the cold.

scenario.summary: Three crashlanded nomads in tundra gear.
